extracted.intended_audience: users and learners of the Magma computer algebra system (new and prospective users, mathematicians wanting to use Magma)
extracted.subtask_description: An index/overview of the seven main components of Magma's documentation, describing the purpose, scope, and format of each resource to help users choose appropriate learning and reference materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: First Steps in Magma
rubrics_metrics.description: "First Steps in Magma" is a very first guide to Magma, suitable for use in the early stages of learning the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 16 pages; intended as an initial, very first guide for beginners just starting to learn Magma.

rubrics_metrics.name: An Introduction to Magma
rubrics_metrics.description: "An Introduction to Magma" does not assume any previous knowledge of programming languages or specialist knowledge of computer algebra, and provides a gentle introduction to the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 450 pages; aimed at learners who may have no prior programming or computer-algebra background—serves as a gentle, comprehensive introduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handbook of Magma Functions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Magma Handbook gives complete documentation for every language and environmental feature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 900 pages; functions as the comprehensive reference documenting all language features, functions, and environment details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solving Problems with Magma
rubrics_metrics.description: The problem-solving book contains extended examples of Magma code, illustrating how to solve some mathematically-hard problems using Magma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 100 pages; focused on worked examples and problem-solving demonstrations to show how to apply Magma to nontrivial mathematical problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Online Help System
rubrics_metrics.description: The Online Help System offers a variety of levels of information, and, in particular, enables access to the Handbook descriptions of all functions and operators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides multi-level help (overview to detailed reference) and direct access to Handbook entries for functions and operators—useful for interactive, context-sensitive lookup.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Magma HTML Help Document
rubrics_metrics.description: The Magma HTML Help Document contains an overview of Magma based on the Overview nodes of the Magma Online Help System, together with an HTML version of the whole of the Magma Handbook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines an overview with an HTML-formatted complete Handbook for web-based browsing of the full reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Magma Home Page
rubrics_metrics.description: The Magma Home Page can be found at <URL:http://www.maths.usyd.edu.au:8000/comp/magma/Overview.html>.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acts as the central entry point to Magma documentation and resources (link provided).
